messages.content: Hi, saya Priya dari Marketing Ops, Lazada Malaysia. Kami nak setup satu campaign baru untuk Raya Haji promo. Mula-mula boleh register sender identity dulu — type domain, domain `mail.promo.lazada.com.my`, contact `priya.devi@lazada.com.my`, dkim required.
Selamat petang Puan Priya. Saya akan mendaftarkan identiti penghantar domain untuk kempen Raya Haji Lazada. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: register_sender_identity
messages.content: {"sender_id": "snd-lzd-promo-01", "status": "pending_verification", "dkim_records": [{"selector": "em2026", "value": "v=DKIM1;k=rsa;p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4..."}], "spf_record": "v=spf1 include:mail.promo.lazada.com.my ~all", "verification_expires_at": "2026-05-23T17:00:00+08:00"}

DKIM dan SPF records dah dapat. Pasukan domain kami baru selesai add ke DNS. Boleh check status sender ni, dan dalam masa yang sama saya nak create satu email template — name `raya-haji-2026-bm-en`, subject `Selamat Hari Raya Haji — Diskaun Sehingga 60% Hujung Minggu Ini!`, dua-dua HTML dengan plain content version.
Baik Puan, saya akan menyemak status pengesahan dan mencipta template e-mel dwibahasa secara serentak.

function.name: create_email_template
function.arguments:
{"name": "raya-haji-2026-bm-en", "subject": "Selamat Hari Raya Haji — Diskaun Sehingga 60% Hujung Minggu Ini!", "content": {"html": "

Selamat Hari Raya Haji

Sambutlah Hari Raya Haji bersama Lazada! Diskaun sehingga 60% untuk fesyen, elektronik, dan barangan rumah. Promo ini sah dari 5 Jun sehingga 8 Jun 2026 sahaja.

Beli Sekarang", "plain": "Selamat Hari Raya Haji! Diskaun sehingga 60% untuk fesyen, elektronik, dan barangan rumah. 5-8 Jun 2026. Beli sekarang: {{cta_url}}"}, "variables": [{"key": "cta_url", "required": true}, {"key": "first_name", "required": false}], "language": ["ms", "en"], "compliance": {"include_unsubscribe": true, "include_physical_address": true}}

messages.content: {"sender_id": "snd-lzd-promo-01", "status": "verified", "dkim_status": "passed", "spf_status": "passed", "dmarc_status": "passed", "reputation": {"score": 78, "category": "good"}, "verified_at": "2026-05-21T15:42:01+08:00"}

messages.name: create_email_template
messages.content: {"template_id": "tpl-raya-haji-2026-01", "name": "raya-haji-2026-bm-en", "version": 1, "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:42:02+08:00", "compliance_check": {"unsubscribe_present": true, "physical_address_present": true, "spam_score": 1.8}}

Sender verified dan template ready. Sekarang create satu audience segment — type dynamic, criteria customer Malaysia, opted_in true, last_purchase_within 180 days, exclude bounced atau unsubscribed. Anggaran sekitar 850k recipient.
Baik Puan, saya akan mencipta segmen audiens dinamik dengan kriteria tersebut.

messages.name: create_audience_segment
messages.content: {"segment_id": "seg-lzd-my-180d-01", "name": "my-active-shoppers-180d", "type": "dynamic", "estimated_size": 873442, "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:43:11+08:00"}

873k recipient, nampak elok. Sekarang create campaign — name `raya-haji-2026-launch`, sender dan template yang baru tadi, primary segment yang baru ni, schedule send pada 4 Jun 2026 pukul 9 pagi. Configure satu webhook subscription untuk track events delivered, bounced, opened dan clicked ke endpoint `https://hooks.lazada.com.my/email/v1`.
Baik Puan, saya akan mencipta kempen dan menyediakan langganan webhook secara serentak.

messages.name: create_campaign
messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "name": "raya-haji-2026-launch", "status": "scheduled", "send_at": "2026-06-04T09:00:00+08:00", "estimated_recipients": 873442, "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:44:22+08:00"}

messages.name: configure_webhook_subscription
messages.content: {"webhook_id": "wh-lzd-email-01", "status": "active", "endpoint_health": "reachable", "created_at": "2026-05-21T15:44:23+08:00"}
Sebelum kami launch sebenar, saya nak validate readiness. Boleh validate campaign — check semua aspek including dns, throttle limits, content compliance dan suppression overlap.
Baik Puan, saya akan menjalankan pengesahan kesediaan kempen sebelum penjadualan dimuktamadkan.

messages.name: validate_campaign_readiness
messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "overall": "ready_with_warnings", "checks": [{"name": "sender_dns", "status": "pass"}, {"name": "template_compliance", "status": "pass"}, {"name": "throttle_limits", "status": "pass"}, {"name": "suppression_overlap", "status": "warn", "detail": "4,221 recipients overlap with global suppression list — will be excluded automatically."}, {"name": "segment_freshness", "status": "pass"}, {"name": "webhook_reachability", "status": "pass"}]}

4k overlap dah akan exclude — okay. Sebelum kita commit launch besar tu, saya nak buat satu test send sample untuk 200 recipient internal Lazada team dulu. Boleh simulate impact perubahan untuk add test send sample mode kepada existing campaign.
Baik Puan, saya akan mensimulasikan perubahan untuk menambah penghantaran ujian sampel.

messages.name: simulate_campaign_changes
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-camp-raya-001", "impact_estimate": {"additional_cost_myr": 12, "projected_delay_minutes": 5, "deliverability_risk_delta": 0}, "blast_radius": {"affected_recipients_total": 200, "new_dependencies": ["seg-lzd-internal-200"]}, "explain": "Sample test of 200 recipients adds RM 12 cost and 5-minute delay before main blast; no deliverability risk."}

Cost rendah dan delay 5 minit acceptable. Saya nak schedule test send dulu pada hari ini pukul 5 petang. Sebab production launch nanti, saya nak request approval dari Encik Daniel (Head of CRM), in parallel — supaya semua compliance kita ada audit trail.
Baik Puan, saya akan memulakan test send dan menghantar permintaan kelulusan untuk launch utama secara serentak.

function.arguments: {"target_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "change_summary": "Approve Raya Haji 2026 launch: 873,442 recipients, 4 Jun 9am MYT, MRC ~RM 4,300 spend, template tpl-raya-haji-2026-01.", "approvers": [{"stage": 1, "kind": "user", "id": "daniel.lim@lazada.com.my", "role": "Head of CRM", "min_required": 1}], "evidence_refs": ["camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "sim-camp-raya-001"], "due_at": "2026-05-30T17:00:00+08:00"}

messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "send_mode": "test_only", "batch_id": "batch-test-001", "status": "scheduled", "send_at": "2026-05-21T17:00:00+08:00", "estimated_recipients": 200}

messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-camp-raya-001", "status": "pending", "approvers_notified": ["daniel.lim@lazada.com.my"], "expires_at": "2026-05-30T17:00:00+08:00"}

Test send berjaya — pasukan internal confirm dapat dan render betul di Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail. Boleh tarik send status untuk test batch, dan in parallel get message events untuk recipient sample 5 orang untuk verify rendering.
Baik Puan, saya akan menarik status penghantaran ujian dan peristiwa mesej sampel secara serentak.

messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "batch_id": "batch-test-001", "sent": 200, "delivered": 198, "bounced": 2, "deliverability_pct": 99.0, "providers": {"gmail": {"delivered": 132, "inbox_placement_pct": 96.9}, "outlook": {"delivered": 45, "inbox_placement_pct": 91.1}, "apple": {"delivered": 21, "inbox_placement_pct": 100}}}

99% deliverability, click-through dari Daniel sendiri awal. Encik Daniel pun baru ping saya — dia dah approve via portal. Record decision, dan in parallel saya nak start main campaign — confirm send_mode production, tetapkan throttle 40000 per minit untuk elak risiko reputation.
Baik Puan, saya akan merekod kelulusan dan menjadualkan penghantaran kempen utama secara serentak.

function.name: decide_campaign_approval
function.arguments: {"approval_request_id": "appr-camp-raya-001", "decision": "approve", "decided_by": {"user_id": "daniel.lim@lazada.com.my", "role": "Head of CRM", "channel": "portal"}, "comments": "Approved; test send rendered well across major mailbox providers."}

messages.name: decide_campaign_approval
messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-camp-raya-001", "status": "approved", "decided_at": "2026-05-21T17:20:55+08:00"}

messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "send_mode": "production", "batch_id": "batch-prod-001", "status": "scheduled", "send_at": "2026-06-04T09:00:00+08:00", "estimated_recipients": 869221, "estimated_duration_minutes": 22}
Aiyo, baru terima alert — segment kita ada few customer yang banyak duplicate. Saya nak pause main batch dulu untuk re-review segment. Pause dengan reason `segment dedup investigation`.
Baik Puan, saya akan menggantung kempen utama untuk semakan segmen.

messages.content: {"campaign_id": "camp-raya-haji-2026-01", "action": "pause", "new_status": "paused", "paused_at": "2026-05-21T17:23:08+08:00", "remaining_recipients": 869221}
Pasukan data engineering dah confirm — duplicate adalah palsu, segment betul. Saya nak tarik dashboard metrics dan audit history untuk campaign ni sebelum resume.
Baik Puan, saya akan menarik papan pemuka metrik dan sejarah audit secara serentak sebelum penyambungan semula.

Dashboard test phase nampak best — open rate 56%, click 24%. Sekarang saya boleh resume campaign — call pause/cancel dengan action resume, dan in parallel tag campaign sebagai `production-ready` dan `raya-2026-priority`.
Baik Puan, saya akan menyambung semula kempen dan menandakan tag prestasinya secara serentak.

Final step — generate PDF executive summary untuk circulate ke management, dan eksport campaign data ke S3 bucket `lazada-mkt-archive`, prefix `raya-haji-2026-launch`.
Baik Puan, saya akan menjana laporan eksekutif dan mengeksport data secara serentak untuk simpanan jabatan pemasaran.

Berikut ringkasan akhir, Puan Priya:

- **Sender:** `snd-lzd-promo-01` (mail.promo.lazada.com.my) — DKIM/SPF/DMARC verified
- **Template:** `tpl-raya-haji-2026-01` (BM/EN dwibahasa)
- **Segment:** `seg-lzd-my-180d-01` — 873,442 anggaran
- **Campaign:** `camp-raya-haji-2026-01` — scheduled untuk 4 Jun 2026, 9 pagi (production)
- **Test send:** 200 recipient, 99% deliverability, 56.5% open, 24% click
- **Kelulusan:** Encik Daniel CRM Head — diluluskan
- **Webhook:** `wh-lzd-email-01` aktif untuk events tracking
- **Laporan PDF:** [rpt-camp-raya-001-exec.pdf](https://reports.email.my/r/rpt-camp-raya-001-exec.pdf)
- **Eksport CSV:** `s3://lazada-mkt-archive/raya-haji-2026-launch/exp-camp-001.csv.gz`

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang saya boleh bantu sebelum panggilan ditamatkan?
Cukup, terima kasih banyak. Kami akan monitor pada 4 Jun pagi.
Sama-sama, Puan Priya. Terima kasih atas kesabaran. Pasukan platform e-mel akan terus memantau status penghantaran dan akan maklumkan Puan sekiranya ada anomali pada hari launch. Selamat petang.
